rules.statement: In the absence of clear evidence rebutting the presumption of marriage, co-owners are entitled to a share in the land.
rules.supporting_quote: "The facts of this case attract the presumption of marriage between Andiris Appu and Dingihamy and this presumption has not been rebutted by the 3rd defendant. In these circumstances, it has to be held that Andiris Appu was lawfully married to Dingihamy"
